CLEAN_MULTIMODAL.description: Standard unaltered multimodal features from CMU-MOSEI

TEXT_EMBEDDING_NOISE.description: Emulates ASR transcription errors and acoustic drift via Gaussian noise on text embeddings (sigma=0.40)

AUDIO_FEATURE_MASKING.description: Acoustic sensor failure / microphone mute: audio features masked to zero

VISUAL_ZERO_MASK.description: Visual camera occlusion / frame corruption: visual features masked to zero

COMPOUND_FAULT.description: Simultaneous severe text noise (sigma=0.50) + acoustic channel masking

INTERMITTENT_MISSINGNESS.description: Dynamic Bernoulli sensor packet drop: Audio p_drop=0.30, Visual p_drop=0.40, Text p_drop=0.10

HETEROGENEOUS_DEADLINE_STRESS.description: Heterogeneous dynamic QoS stress cycling through 15 ms, 30 ms, and 50 ms deadlines
